messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Synthetic canary 'global-synth-5m' failing in APAC and EU - spike in 3xx responses across probes. Probe error_rate 18% over 5m window. PagerDuty escalation triggered -> INC-2026-3842 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC-2026-3842 - Triggered by rule 'synth-canary-3xx-threshold' (severity: P2). Acknowledgement required. Link: https://pd.example/INC-2026-3842
jamie (oncall): acked INC-2026-3842 :hand: I'm on it. pinging @matt and @priya. initial thought: routing or edge LB returning 3xxs?
matt (sre): looking. pulling canary runner logs now. can we get raw probe responses? @deploy-bot can you attach last 200 lines?
deploy-bot: attach: /var/log/synth/global-synth-5m/1710207700-1710207770.log (snippet)
neil (se): seeing 302 -> /auth/redirect in many responses, looks like probes are being redirected to an auth flow intermittently. could be cookie/KV change on edge.
priya (platform): checking ingress/auth config. no recent deploys in APAC/EU in last 24h from platform side. did identity team rotate something? @neil which backend returned the 302? sample: ``HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: https://login.example.com/sso?from=/probe/123
Server: redwood-edge/2.4.1``
matt (sre): grep in logs: a subset of edge nodes are returning 302. node ids: edge-apac-07, edge-eu-03. investigating whether a policy change rolled to a subset.
neil (se): customer-impact check: traffic routing to prod not affected AFAICT, internal canary traffic using a different path hit the redirect. but if edge rollout continues it could affect client API auth flows. estimate: low customer impact now but rising.
jamie (oncall): creating short mitigation plan: 1) disable canary runner in APAC/EU to stop PagerDuty noise, 2) run targeted curl tests against edge nodes, 3) escalate to infra if config rollback needed, 4) handoff to next oncall after mitigation. Agreed? :white_check_mark:
matt (sre): +1. disabling canary job now. ``kubectl -n synth patch cronjob global-synth-5m -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'`` -> applied. verifying no more pages.
incident-bot: Synthetic job 'global-synth-5m' suspended by jamie (oncall) at 1710207855. Paging suppressed for that job.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC-2026-3842 acknowledged by jamie (oncall).
priya (platform): dug into config: a canary ACL pushed to edge nodes earlier today accidentally included a redirect rule for probe path /probe/. rolling back that change to edge pool via rollout id r-2026-448. initiating rollback target edge-apac and edge-eu subset. ``edgectl rollout r-2026-448 --pools=apac,europe --strategy=fast-undo``
matt (sre): confirming rollback logs show successful rollback on edge-apac-07 and edge-eu-03. re-running targeted curl checks: ``for n in edge-apac-07 edge-eu-03; do curl -svS http://$n/probe/health || true; done`` -> responses now 200.
neil (se): running light synthetic dry-run for 15m to validate. will re-enable job only when stable. communicating to SRE/Platform channels.
jamie (oncall): updating incident notes: root cause = accidental ACL redirect rule rollout to subset of edge pools causing 3xx responses for probe paths. customer impact = low/contained (no API 5xxs observed). mitigation = suspend canary, rollback ACL, validate, re-enable.
priya (platform): filing follow-up with config-owner (team: edge-config) and adding preflight check for /probe/ path to deployment pipeline. filing ticket EDGE-1249.
matt (sre): handing off to next oncall @neil for post-mortem followup. jamie -> neil 10:30 handoff. pd note: close INC once synth stable for 30m.
jamie (oncall): handing off. please ack receipt and take ownership of post-incident tasks. :handshake:
neil (se): ack - taking ownership. will coordinate postmortem and timeline. will re-enable canary at ~1710209800 if dry-run clean.
incident-bot: NOTE: page suppression active. watchlist updated.
jamie (oncall): marking thread for postmortem. closing my active duties. :v:
